Zvi Benami Embedding Fine-Tuning = changing what the model sees Changing retrieval behavior not vectors What Actually Changes Improves ranking of retrieved results Adjusts relative semantic distances Encodes domain-specific meaning Does not change how text is generated What Does Not Happen: Vectors in the database are not edited No manual pushing" vectors closer or farther Model concept: f(text) vector Fine-tuning changes f, not existing vectors.
